name: Bonfires Burning Bright
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT Martinique Rum Barrel Aged Barley Wine With Caramel, Pumpkin And Pumpkin Spice Blend CELLAR MASTER NOTES“Build a man a fire, and he'll be warm for a day. Set a man on fire, and he'll be warm for the rest of his life.”Oh, dang, here we go again with a special blend that started out as a one-time-keg-only drop. But since we're going down this way, we got a decent amount of superb quality pumpkin and spiced up the season with this sweet, caramelly, woody, bit vegetal craziness in bottles as well. The Martinique rum barrel itself gave much spiciness, but the kind of misfits we are, we totally embrace the “a little more can't hurt” philosophy. So just treat yourself and taste our non-typical festive release before the lights go out.

name: Mr. Wonderful
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTRye Bourbon Barrel-Aged Caramel Barleywine With Pistachios, Orange And Lemon Zests, VanillaCELLAR MASTER NOTES"Why you think I'm out here actin' crazy?"Our brand new creation is rising high with the flavors of the baklava, the galaxy’s most beloved dessert. A massively caramelly sweetness as a backbone shows the mild spiciness of rye and oak, while the dominating tasting note comes from the roasted pistachios, nicely balanced out by the citrus zests, so the final product won't be too sticky. Already thinking about another version focusing more on the chocolaty notes... Who knows? Life is crazy.

name: Liquid Florentine
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBarley Wine aged in Bourbon Barrel with hand-roasted Almond, Orange, Cocoa Beans, Orange Zest and SaltCELLAR MASTER NOTESMirror mirror on the wall, give Florentine to all!This time it seems like we managed to create the universal cookie beer because, despite Florentine being the main inspiration, every single one of us in the brewery was reminded of a different sweet treat after tasting: fruit bread, orange sponge cake, Sacher-cake, Túró Rudi (just Google this curd snack), you know the drill. What's for sure is that we've added a copious amount of hand-roasted almond as a backbone, hit on the taste and created acidity with orange, used the bitter greatness of cocoa and rounded it up with a hint of salt. The result can hardly be described in a written form, but if you are into pastry-inspired but not overwhelmingly sweet beers, this one will eat you alive.

name: Bourbon & Bourbon
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT Bourbon Whiskey barrel aged barleywine with Bourbon barrel aged coffee and maple syrup CELLAR MASTER NOTES This beer is special due to the addition of Bourbon Barrel aged coffee. This is the first release, where the inspiration didn't come from the base beer, nor the barrel, but the extra addition. Beer and barrel were selected after choosing the Bourbon BA coffee. The nose and taste are dominated by the fruity notes of lightly roasted coffee complemented by cinnamon and caramel notes of the maple syrup barlywine and Bourbon barrel.

name: Franky (2019)
text: Barley wine-unk, a Franky 2019-es évjárata. A stílusra jellemző komplex és intenzív malátás jegyek jellemzik, valamint nagy test és viszkózus kortyérzet. Ízében és illatában a dió, a melasz és az aszalt gyümölcsök dominálnak, de melegítés hatására előbújnak a juharszirupos-karamellás aromák is. Kiváló téli sör, magas érlelési potenciállal.-----The vintage 2019 version of our barley wine, Franky. Full-bodied with a viscous mouthfeel. Complex maltiness, with notes of dried fruits, walnut, maple syrup and molasses. Perfect for the winter season. Cellarable.

name: Walrus 2: The Revenge Of The 'Nuss
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTA blend of Four Roses and Knob Creek Rye bourbon barrel-aged barley wines with in house-roasted walnut and vanillaCELLAR MASTER NOTESThe Walrus is back in town and this time he totally GOES NUTSWhen we experimented with 'I am The Walnut' a decision was made that besides the beast we have to create his evil twin: a darker, older, but still gentle brother. So we put tons and tons of hand-roasted walnuts into two different barrels of barley wine and rounded it up with vanilla. A sequel from an alternative universe! As a result, this bad boy has the chocolaty-nutty notes of walnut, that go just perfectly with the woody-spicy bourbon feel. And yes, you can say it's boring to say this (again), but in our opinion, this is our best one so far: revenge has never tasted this good! Like a good-old VHS blockbuster, you want to check it again, again and again.

name: I Am the Walnut
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTJamaican rum barrel-aged barleywine with walnut, mahlep and tonka beansCELLAR MASTER NOTESIf you search carefully you may find traces of beer in this liquid walnut syrup.We experimented a lot with spice additions while working on this release to find the perfect combination. Finally, the interplay of walnut, tonka and mahlep came out as the winner combo.Yes, I know your question and the answer is: mahlep is an aromatic spice made from the seeds of a species of cherry providing the characteristics of bitter almond, cherry and marzipan. These notes perfectly match with the deep-woody walnut savors and the vibrating spiciness of tonka that strengthens up the presence of barrel-inflicted flavors.

name: Tiny Barrel Project Old King Clancy Bourbon
text: From OLD KING CLANCY 2017 Maple Syrup Barleywine to OLD KING CLANCY 2022 Maple Syrup Barleywine, here's TINY BARREL PROJECT OLD KING CLANCY BOURBON Clermont Springs Bourbon Barrel Aged Barleywine with our friends TEYFÖL (Szentendre, Hungary) Bistro Here's our 7th TINY BARREL PROJECT release (and the 2nd in 2024) within our recently introduced category between the Specials series and Barrel Project in 330ml cans, dropping on the 10th of May, 2024 celebrating TEYFÖL's 1st Birthday!

name: Mayhem Of Mash
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT collab with our old friend Mario from Bådin Bryggeri (NO)A Blend Of Bourbon Barrel-aged Caramel Barleywine And Tokaji Aszú Sweet Wine Barrel-aged RyewineCELLAR MASTER NOTESMadness? We eat mayhem for breakfast!Although we are big fans of blending barrels and beer styles, this one is a first, even for us. It’s also our debut collab with our friends at Bådin, and we went all in. We started with a highly aromatic, slightly dry ryewine aged in Hungarian Tokaji Aszú barrels as our thesis. Then we brought in the antithesis, a bold, sweet, toffee-laced barleywine straight out of a bourbon barrel. The result? A synthesis that’s not overwhelmingly sweet, but rich, spicy, and biscuit-like, with layers to get lost in. Oh, and it contains a nice mixture of grains as barley, rye, and oat, so don't worry about the 12%, technically, it still qualifies as breakfast granola.

name: Old King Clancy 2022

name: Great Fireballs of Fire
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTPort Wine Barrel-aged Barley Wine With Cinnamon And HoneyCELLAR MASTER NOTESOh, you cinnamonical phantasmagoria, rise now and come to life!Adding cinnamon to your beer is almost always a good idea, but this time we really wanted to create something crazy (to be honest, we do this on a daily basis). We used tons of cinnamon sticks and roasted them well, so we ended up with a more intense and sharp flavor that pairs well with the red fruity-caramelly-nutty base embracing perfectly the sweetness of the unfermented honey. Not gonna lie, it's not that hard to figure out the source of inspiration here, as we tried to get the same intense, hot, cinnamon flavors as the infamous whiskey liquor goes. If you ask us, we nailed it.

name: Lady Lockdown
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTEx-Reposado Mezcal Barrel Aged Barleywine  CELLAR MASTER NOTESThe exciting and pleasant combination of walnut, raisin, smoke and spiciness will make you wish you opened a brewery in Mexico.This surprisingly strong barleywine has sat more than a year in a reposado mezcal barrel, so enough time was given for the light smoky character and fruity spiciness, just like the oakiness of the barrel, to be soaked up. The base beer didn't come with empty hands either: the nutty, grapy and date-like tastes will get you at first sip, no matter if there's a lockdown or not.

name: Bran
text: Grain Whisky Barrel Aged BarleywinePontosan két éven keresztül pihent whiskyhordóban érlelődve első árpaborunk - és nem hiába. A barley wine természetes gyümölcsössége, mazsolás-karamellás ízvilága és a whisky gabonás, halvány édessége tökéletesen passzolnak össze egy testes, de masszívan egyedi ízekkel és illatokkal sűrűn telerakott különlegességhez.

name: Never Ending Trails
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT Team Series BalázsRye Bourbon Barrel-Aged Quadruple With Roasted Nuts And Dried ApricotCELLAR MASTER NOTESYou are now holding a precious, secret potion in your hand, the kind that humanity pursues to find for thousands of years, the ultimate key to eternal life, spiced up with the sweetest nut blend ever createdIf you think we're done with all the nut additions in our beers, you are definitely wrong. Moreover, we just started to feel how berserk we can go with these energy bombs! On a decadent rye bourbon barrel-aged quadrupel base, all of these dried fruity notes are amplified with additional dried apricots as a final twist. Ideal as a snack for those daylong hikes, you know, the ones that you wish would last forever.

name: Egomaniac Simcoe
text: DDH DIPA 8 %When Egomaniac came out in 2018, we introduced a hop addition of 30g/liter which was by that time the most anyone has ever done in Hungary. By now, we are pretty sure, that this is not the case anymore, but we still consider this one a really nice recipe for a beer.Egomaniac is single-hop, trying to showcase the very characteristic of a single variety of hops. Originally this was Citra, but with this one, it is one of our other inhouse favorite: Simcoe. Today, these hops are considered veteran classics of the industry but we can't help it. We still love to use them. When we tried to characterize Simcoe, we came up with the words pomelo and passion fruit. It really depends on your crop and the brew itself too, but this is what we have.When we rebrewed Egomaniac now in 2020, we were so curious about what we can achieve with it using our knowledge in brewing by that time. We are curious again, especially because we can finally package this one in its perfect form: a 0,44 can.

Az alapot rengeteg kakaóbab törettel főztük, majd extra adag csokoládéval tettük igazán dekadenssé. A laktóz selymes textúrát és desszertszerű kortyérzetet ad – ez egy igazi folyékony csokoládé-élmény!-A creamy, sweet, double chocolate porter aged in Bourbon barrels for a rich blend of vanilla and roasted notes. Brewed with loads of cocoa nibs and extra chocolate for full decadence. Lactose adds silky texture and a dessert-like finish – pure liquid chocolate bliss!

name: Night Shift 2024 - Imperial Milk Porter Aged In Pedro Ximénez Sherry & Rum Barrels W. Sour Cherry & Poppy Seed
text: Az első Imperial Milk Porter tervezésekor tudtuk, hogy egy nagyon különleges tételt szeretnénk készíteni, amit ráadásul egyben gyümölcsös Night Shift tételnek is terveztünk. A leerjedt alapsör, frissen ürített Pedro Ximénez Sherry és rumos hordókban pihent 6 hónapot, hogy a hordó fás ízjegyei kiemeljék az alapsör meggyes, mákos, enyhén tejcsokis ízvilágát, megalkotva ezt az igazán sütis jellegű, testes tételt. When designing the first Imperial Milk Porter, we knew we wanted to create something very special, which we also envisioned as a fruity Night Shift batch. The condensed base beer was transferred to freshly emptied Pedro Ximénez Sherry and rum barrels for 6 months, allowing the woody notes of the barrel to enhance the base beer's cherry, poppyseed, and subtly milky chocolate flavor profile, creating this truly pastry-like, full-bodied batch.

name: Kings & Queens - 7th Anniversary Aszú Barrel Aged Imperial Flanders Red Ale
text: Ahogy tavaly lefőztük az ország legerősebb sörét (Watery Spirit 6th Anniversary Barley Wine, 22% vol.), úgy idén is valami igazán különlegeset szeretnénk nektek adni. A hetedik évfordulós sörünk egy aszú hordóban, aszú szemeken két évig érlelt flamand vörös ale lett, de mit is jelent ez a gyakorlatban?A flamand vörös egy tradicionális sörtípus Belgiumból, annak is a nyugati területéről származik, általában a "hagyományos" sörélesztőn kívül, Lactobacillust és alkalomadtán Brettanomyces-t is használnak az erjesztéshez, amitől savanyú és gyümölcsös karaktert egyaránt kap a sör. Jellemző rá a hosszú, fahordós érlelés, ami még jobban felerősíti a savas hatást. A sötétebb malátás -, aszalt gyümölcsös -, és fahordós jegyek miatt "Belgium burgundijaként" is hivatkoznak rá a műértők. Legismertebb tételeit a stílusnak a Rodenbach főzde készíti az 1800-as évektől.A mi esetünkben is egy speciális élesztőkultúrát és egy klasszikus flamand vörös receptet használtunk az alapsörhöz, majd a sört a HOLDVÖLGY-től kapott tokaji aszús hordókban érleltük két évig, ráadásul kézzel válogatott aszúszemeken pihentettük a sört a hordóban.A végeredmény pedig egy igazi kuriózum lett, valahol a sör és egy jó tokaji aszú határmezsgyéjén. Színre vöröses-barnás, az aszús, édes, brandys (aszalt sárgabarack) jegyek szépen kiegészítik a sör savanyú, funky-s, "lambicos" jegyeit. A hordós érlelés ad egy diós, mandulás plusz réteget a sörnek, a 13.7%-os alkoholtartalom ellenére nem lóg ki belőle az alkohol.

text: A Tropical Identity Crisis a legújabb smoothie sörünk, amelyet a rengeteg gyümölcs és a fagyipor tesz igazán sűrűvé. A mangó, banán, maracuja és ananász trópusi karaktert ad az italnak, amelyet a kókusz aromája lágyít. De ha már így alakult, az ital legalább megvan hozzá.///Tropical Identity Crisis is our latest smoothie sour, made thick with lots of fruit and ice cream powder. Mango, banana, passion fruit, and pineapple give the drink its tropical character, which is softened by the aroma of coconut. The end result is a can of Pina Colada, which would be perfect for sparkling sunshine, 40-degree weather, and the beach - too bad it's March. text: Megnyitjuk az idei nyarat egy brutál MONYO-fagyival: ez a legújabb MOJO-őrület!Nem bírtunk magunkkal és felültünk az Ice Cream vonatra mi is és főztünk egy brutál cuccos, sűrű és krémes ice cream smoothie sourt összesen több, mint 40% mangó- és őszibarackpürével. A kész sört aztán fagyiporral sűrítettük be, végül pedig vaníliával és mandulával fejeltük meg. A végeredmény egy igazi nyári sör lett, ami tökéletesen hozza a fagyivibe-okat: gyümölcsös, édes és sűrű mint az olvadt fagylalt.Fontos, hogy tartsd hűtve és fogyaszd frissen, mert csak úgy lesz az igazi!Fogyasztás előtt pedig forgasd meg a cant!We’re kicking off summer with a MONYO ice cream bomb — the latest MOJO madness is here!We couldn’t resist jumping on the ice cream train ourselves, so we brewed a rich, thick, and creamy ice cream smoothie sour loaded with over 40% mango and peach purée. Then we thickened it up even more with ice cream powder and finished it off with a touch of vanilla and almond.The result? A true summer brew that brings all the ice cream vibes: fruity, sweet, and as thick as melted gelato.Keep it cold and drink it fresh — that’s how it’s best!And don’t forget to gently swirl the can before opening!

name: Night Shift Vintage 2024 - Triticale Wine Aged In Gemenc Whiskey & Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: Till Áron sörfőzőnk ötlete. A tritikálé, ami a búza és a rozs keresztezéséből született hibrid, mindkét alapgabona íz- és illatjegyeit magában hordozza, és ezt maga a sör, illetve a hordós érlelés csak jobban kihozta. A sör egyik felét a Gemenc Whiskey-től kapott, tritikálé alapú whiskey-t érlelt hordóiban érleltük, a másik fele Tennessee hordókba került, majd ennek a blendjéből született meg a végleges forma. Triticale, a hybrid of wheat and rye, carries the flavor and aroma characteristics of both base grains, and the beer itself, along with barrel aging, brings these out even more. We aged half of the beer in barrels from Gemenc Whiskey, which had been used to age triticale-based whiskey, the other half went into Tennessee barrels.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2025 / Buckwheat Wine Aged In Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: Tennessee Whiskey hordóban érlelt hajdinabor2025-ben is folytatjuk a gabonabor-sorozatunkat - de most valami egészen szokatlan jön.Ezúttal a hajdina kapta a főszerepet: egy Ázsiából származó növény, amit ugyan nem gabonafélének, mégis annak használunk, hiszen magjából liszt készül, mint a búzából.Mi a hajdinát malátázott formában tettük az alapsörbe, majd Tennessee Whiskey hordókban érleltük, amíg ki nem bontakozott teljes, gazdag, gabonaboros karaktere.Ne tévesszen meg a név — ez nem a „hajdinabor”, amit desztillálnak vagy fermentálnak, hanem egy különleges, sörként főzött gabonabor, tele a hajdina földes, diós mélységeivel és a whiskey hordók meleg, vaníliás aromáival.-Buckwheat Grain Wine - Aged in Tennessee Whiskey BarrelsIn 2025, we’re continuing our experimental grain wine series — but this time, we’re doing something truly unconventional.Meet the buckwheat edition: a plant native to Asia, not technically a grain, yet often used as one thanks to its wheat-like seeds.We used malted buckwheat in the base beer, then aged it in Tennessee Whiskey barrels until it reached its perfect, rich, grain wine character.Don’t confuse this with traditional “buckwheat wine” — this isn’t distilled or fermented like wine. It’s a beer-based grain wine, showcasing the earthy, nutty depth of buckwheat, beautifully rounded by warm vanilla and oak notes from the whiskey barrels.

text: Singularity is an ode to boozy, creamy coffee.A big coffee and chocolate malt body, full of toffee and raw sugar notes, serves as the foundation, balanced with a touch of lactose. We then cold-infuse a specially-selected blend of single-origin beans from Budapest's own Bagira Coffee: two Brazilian roasts for creamy, nougaty espresso character, and an El Salvadorian dark roast for tobacco and red fruit notes.

text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Milk Stout With Mexican Vanilla BeansCELLAR MASTER NOTESJust a kind invitation to our very own simulation if you are willing to open your mindAfter 3 releases in two years, we return with one of our most popular series, Simulation Theory. This year we decided to get one of the most famous varieties of this precious spice, the Mexican, and put it in an even more sticky and creamy base beer which is enriched with lactose and candid sugar. The result is sweet and aromatic with pleasant notes of wood and chocolate. If you are lucky enough you may have one or two bottles left from the previous releases so you can tag along. name: Horror Vacui
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTScotch And Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout With Smoked Cocoa, Rosemary And Smoked SaltCELLAR MASTER NOTESWe are simple brewersIf we find emptiness in the sip, we fill it with weird plants and strange salts. From time to time we take big risks and move away from the comfort zone of nuts-vanilla-sweet spices to try some nonsense. In this case, the motivation came from culinary experiences where the rosemary, the cocoa, and the salt are long-time friends, so why not to try them in beer, maybe alongside with some smoke? The base itself is a blend of scotch and bourbon barrel-aged imperial stout that brings chocolate, vanilla, and strong oak notes to the party. The result is an unusual banger (according to our humble opinion, of course).

name: Happy Finish Tawny Port
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBlended Barrel Aged Imperial Stout and PorterCELLAR MASTER NOTESIn this bottle you can find the wonderful unity between our very first - but definitely not the last - Tawny Port Barrel aged imperial porter and a Cuban rum Barrel aged imperial peanut stout.We have filled one of our first casks in the brewery back in 2018 with the porter. It wasn't a quick finish as the taste needed almost 2 years to mature, but the vibrating duo of raisin and sour cherry will convince you, just like the tannic tones at the end of the sip, that patience is a virtue. It takes two to make a quarrel though; Cuban rum rounds the composition with notes of bitter chocolate and walnut. The results? Close your eyes and succumb to the temptation of our Cognac sour cherry bonbon...

However, don’t be confused… You always deserve the finest, and we strive to provide it. Open a bottle, fill your glass, fill your soul, and drink like the royalty you are.

name: Coco-Choco Armageddon
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout with roasted coconut and cocoa beansCELLAR MASTER NOTESWe know. Talking about Bounty in a coconut-chocolate stout is such a cliché but we cannot afford not to do so. From the first sniff until the last sip coconut is everywhere complemented by a more bitter than sweet chocolate tone. A little vanilla and lots of chocolate come from the bourbon barrel but this time we resisted the temptation and didn't add more vanilla to the composition as the true character of chocolate seemed to be more fascinating. Our second BA coconut imperial stout (after Monster Monday) flashes a completely different side of this nut (that isn't actually a nut).

name: When They Bring The Nasty Riff Back But Slower
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTMezcal And Hot Sauce Barrel Aged Imperial Stout With Cocoa, Chillies And SpicesThe Barrel Aged Version of our previous collab with Adroit Theory (USA) NASTY RIFFCELLAR MASTER NOTESHushed and GrimmedThe Nasty Riff came back. You believed Nasty Riff was a one-hit-wonder… But you were all deceived. Damn right son, another version was made. In the dark depths of the barrel room, in a mezcal and a hot sauce barrel, this few hundred liters of this bitingly intense imperial stout was put aside to wait for its time to strike again. Very light hint of spicy smokiness and an even deeper form of chili and hotness. This release will be our second form of collaboration with the mighty Adroit Theory but if we can tell you a secret, a third will emerge soon!

name: Simulation Theory 2023 Tahiti
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTBourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout With Tahitian VanillaCELLAR MASTER NOTESJust a kind invitation to our very own simulation if you are willing to open your mindThis beer is not just the revival of the infamous Simulation Theory originally released back in 2019, but also part of a miniseries, where we created an upgraded imperial stout base, divided it into 2 parts, and then filled them into similar Kentucky bourbon barrels, to finish them with 2 different kinds of vanilla to see what happens, focusing on the contrasts. Hereby we cordially invite you on this journey to discover all these amazing nuances. Spoiler alert: both of them are incredibly walnutty-chocolaty from the barrel itself and the Tahiti and Madagascar vanillas are in perfect symbiosis with these flavors. We're not here to judge though. Only you are!

name: EVOLUTION 2021 COCOA
text: Brewed in november 2020, this rye imperial stout is extremely oily and complex. Infused with Venezuelan and Nicaraguan Cocoa nibs.

name: Extreme Plum Terror
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTCuban Rum Barrel Aged Imperial Stout With Dried Plum And CinnamonCELLAR MASTER NOTESIn disorder you can always find harmony.As the seventh son of this batch of imperial stout (with brothers like Ghost of a Rose, Mr. Peanutbutter, Choco-Coco Armageddon), this bastard delivers a seventh totally different variety for a stout: fruits and spices. It was the first time we used dried fruits to a BA release and it has turned out very lovely with the raisiny sweet notes of plum and got perfectly completed by the woody-spicy cinnamon and the moderately strong but quite deep flavors of the Cuban rum barrel. Maybe it's time to bring fruits to Barrel Project and unleash chaos? Hell yeah.

name: Never Before #1
text: Port ruby BA double imperial stout on raspberry

name: EVOLUTION 2020
text: 2020. január 3-án főztük. Olajosan sűrű, édes, komplex sörital a hidegebb napokra.Összesen 350 palack készült.

name: Chef's Bottle
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT team series Norbert Piszkor [Madhouse Budapest executive chef]Jamaican Rum Barrel Aged Imperial StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESDo not eat. Taste. Savor. Relish.In general, our brewery doesn't embrace the mindset of "Simple is better" but sometimes it comes in that beautiful form we are just unable to ignore it. For this release, we used a freshly emptied Jamaican rum barrel and filled it up with our base imperial stout we've been improving for years now to provide the perfect backbone for our barrel project. The result is a chocolaty-spicy-somewhat fruity, full-bodied, yet not sweet, thick, black stout which never ceases to amaze the crew, anytime we pop a bottle.

name: Tennessee Dice Roller
text: Imperial Stout with Almond and VanillaTry it - pair it - blend it with QUEEN OF GRACELAND Imperial Milk Shake Pale Ale with Sour Cherry and Coconut

name: Mr. Peanutbutter
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT Double Barrel Aged Imperial StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESImagine a spoon of peanut butter that is so thick you can't even swallow it. Now imagine it in a beer.The substance you can find in this bottle had a more exciting past than most of us. We started with brewing an amazingly strong and rich imperial stout with tons of peanuts and aged it in a Four Roses barrel. When the taste of bourbon got vibrant after a year, we poured it into a Pedro Ximenez sherry barrel for a finish and as a final act, a crazy amount of peanut has been added again. All of these efforts turned into a wonderful unity between wood, vanilla, chocolate, cherry, plum, and at last but not least: P-E-A-N-U-T!

name: Stachio Bois
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT Bourbon Barrel Aged Vanilla Bean Pistachio Cake Imperial Pastry StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESPistachio is the king of the nut family so we didn't hesitate to put a golden crown on this bottle. But wax is far from being the only thing that makes it noble: it sat for more than a year in a bourbon barrel and we added vanilla to round up the tastes and balance the light saltiness. To be honest, we had nothing to do here: the enormous amount of nuts did most of the job. The chocolaty stout mixed with the oriental vibes of pistachios got twisted by a bit of vanilla, it is soft with moderated carbonation, and the feeling it delivers is royal. We recommend it to everybody who's ready to admire a sticky-toffee-nutty-chocolaty-vanilla boi.

name: Supernova - Imperial Almond Stout
text: Supernova builds on our core range almond stout's incredible reception, pushing Nova's recipe deep into imperial territory to create a luxuriously rich, complex version for our stout fans.This is an enormous beer: rich aromas of roasted almonds lead into a silky smooth, oat-heavy base full of dark chocolate notes tempered with a touch of lactose sweetness.Long conditioning on toasted cherry wood adds further depth to turn Supernova into a truly indulgent treat, perfect for any winter evening.

name: Evolution 2023
text: Our rye imporial stout with 8 types of malts. Oily body, komplex taste.

name: Never Before #3
text: Tawny portwood whiskey BA double imperial stout

name: Evolution 2020 Cocoa
text: Brewed in january 2020, this rye imperial stout is extremely oily and complex. Infused with Venezuelan and Nicaraguan Cocoa nibs. 225 bottles where made.

name: Uenuku
text: Ezt az Imperial Stoutot a tartályérlelés után három részre osztottuk. Egy Martinique mellett két jamaicai (egy szűz és egy használt tölgy) rumoshordóban érleltük 8 hónapig, mielőtt blendeléssel újra egyesítettük.This Imperial Stout was split into three parts after fermentation. These were then filled into 3 barrels: a Martinique and two Jamaican rum (one virgin, on used). After 8 months these parts were once again reunited trough blending.

name: Zenith - Imperial Chocolate Orange Stout
text: Thanks to a double dose of Gravity-roasted Peruvian cacao nibs, this luxuriously boozy milk chocolate stout evokes memories of steaming cups of hot cocoa and delicious Christmas desserts.Cold nitrogenation rounds out the mouthfeel by delivering an incredibly smooth body and creamy head, while a delicate orange marmalade finish gently brings you back to your senses for another sip.

name: Only The Mad Are Sane
text: A Blend Of Maple Syrup Barrel-Aged Imperial Stout, Martinique Rum Barrel-Aged Ryewine And Smoky Whisky Barrel-Aged Sweet Mead collab with our friend Erwin from Van Moll (NL) 4 kegs ever made for Van Moll Fest Winter Edition 2025

name: Moment In Time 2025: Heaven Hill Bourbon
Never Before #2
text: Tawny port BA double impreial stout

name: Tagaloa
text: Az Uenuku alapját is képező Imperial Stoutot ehhez a sörhöz Kentucky Bourbon hordókban érleltük, majd blendeltük. A krémes test mellé kiválóan párosulnak a bourbon jegyei!The same Imperial Stout that formed the basis to Uenuku was also aged in different Kentucky Bourbon barrels, then blended together. The creamy body pairs great with the bourbon's notes!

name: Lords of the Barrel - Vanilla & Tonka Beans
text: A duó  második tagja is rendkívül komplex ízvilággal rendelkezik. Nem émelyítően édes, hanem gyönyörűen lekerekített, sárgabarack befőtt ízeket villant, miközben a tonkabab és a vanília felváltva mutatkozik meg, valódi szépséggé alakítva ezt az alkoholtartalma miatt veszélyes szörnyeteget.

name: Nolala Land
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTMaple Syrup Barrel-Aged Imperial Stout With Pecan NutsCELLAR MASTER NOTES"It's a soul sense of prideGood lord, the South is blind"As a new thing, we started to use bourbon barrels for aging that were previously filled with maple syrup. Well, it turned out pretty awesome, it gave us much more taste than we would ever thought. As the cherry on top, we added a decent amount of handroasted pecan nuts to enhance the pleasure even more so we invite you to dive under with us to the depths of this woody, thick and nutty swamp.

name: Sleeping Giant
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTRum and Bourbon Double Barrel Aged Imperial StoutCELLAR MASTER NOTESThe giant slept for a year in Barbados rum barrels, then rested half more year in a second fill Woodford bourbon barrel. The double barrel aging made it an outstandingly complex beer. It smells like the childhood memory of roasting marshmallows on the campfire. This memory is complemented by coconut and burnt sugar. The beer bids farewell with a night long mouthfeel.

name: Mahuika
text: Alapja ugyanaz az Imperial Stout, amire Uenuku és Tagaloa is épül. Ezúttal a blendeléshez bourbon és brandy hordókban érlelt hányadokat használtunk fel, egy izgalmas, karakteres ízprofilért.The same base Imperial Stout that is shared with Uenuku and Tagaloa, aged in a blend of Bourbon and Brandy barrels.

name: Mango Cvlt
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTJamaican Rum Barrel-Aged Imperial Stout With Dried MangoCELLAR MASTER NOTES “Real smart begins when you quit quoting other people.”Sometimes it’s not that hard to tell if the sequel is better or worse than the original one. But with this one, things are getting really messy. As the second part of our 'aging imperial stouts in rum barrels and finishing them with dried fruits' miniseries (if you remember Pineapple Popup), we now used sundried mango that gave a similar vibe like pineapple: a tropical blast and the kiss of the summer built into a robust, spicy imperial stout. Who knows, maybe we'll end up as a trilogy with Papaya in the lead role!

name: Night of the Witch
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT Gin Barrel Aged Imperial Stout with Pine Nuts, Pine Buds and Juniper BerriesCELLAR MASTER NOTESIt's the night of the witch, our coven sets your heart on fire‌It would be hard to deny that we have some special feelings towards the pines, the pines, where the sun never shines, so it was just a matter of time after Lumbersexual, Timbersexual or Needles and Pins that we released a Barrel Project within this theme. Celebrating Dopelord's new record, Night of the Witch attacks with a serious amount of pine nuts, freshly picked spruce tips and juniper berries. The result is an odd, somewhat Sahti-themed imperial stout with piney freshness and nutty deepness, absolutely not for everyone, but definitely for you.

name: From the Barrel Bourbon Barrel Aged Pecan Imperial Stout (2025)
text: A Wilderness Trail bourbon hordó és a pekándió elegáns párosa egy végtelenül komplex, rétegzett imperial stoutban vegyül el. Erőteljes, kifinomult, és olyan gazdag, hogy szinte harapni lehet.The elegant pairing of a Wilderness Trail bourbon barrel and pecan melds into an endlessly complex, layered imperial stout. Powerful, refined, and so rich you can practically bite into it.

name: Tiny Barrel Project Phat Boi Sherry
text: Even prettier, even hotter, even thicker! Our instant classic '4 bean' imperial stout needs no introduction to dark beer lovers, PHAT BOI is a dynamic blend of natural flavours and real ingredients! The tonka, cocoa, coffee and vanilla infused base has spent over a year in Oloroso Sherrys barrels, which has brought the creamy-cocoa palate to the forefront, while also adding raisins, red berries and woody notes to the mix.The first TINY BARREL PROJECT release in 2024 in collaboration with our friends Jégkert craft beer bar.

name: Collision Course - Imperial Salted Chocolate Stout
text: Collision Course is an adult chocolate experience: a full-bodied bittersweet sipping cocoa packed with the richest ingredients and boldest flavors.A double dose of dark-roasted Peruvian cacao nibs soak in a luxurious caramel and chocolate malt base, while a touch of umami-packed red miso lends salinity to the finish and savory depth to the palate. This explosive dark chocolate body is tempered with soft vanilla notes from toasted oak, patiently developed on our own proprietary infusion system.

text: Our Roasters Paradise collab series with CASINO MOCCA including the trio of ROASTERS PARADISE KIANDERI - KENYA, ROASTERS PARADISE KOKE SHALAYE - ETIÓPIA and ROASTERS PARADISE JAGUARA - BRAZÍLIA has been our favorite coffee releases forever. As an elevation for this project, we wanted to transfer this experience into our other smash-hit series, TINY BARREL PROJECT:Following TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD RUM and TINY BARREL PROJECT CANDY MAN SCOTCH and so, here is our 13th TINY BARREL PROJECT release in our new category between the Specials series and Barrel Project in 330ml cans.Love project meets love project - who else could have been our collab partners for this one-of-a-kind experience, than MADHOUSE BUDAPEST. Get this release if you can, only 1 keg ever made for our downtown bistro & bar together with a really limited number of cans!

name: Lords of the Barrel - Coffee
text: A Mad Scientist és a Reketye sörfőzde többéves tapasztalata a hordóérlelésű sörök területén, a sok szakmai beszélgetés, az izzó sörszerelem eredménye ez a remekmű.Ízében a hordó vaníliás jegyei vannak előtérben, mellette menetel a Casino Mocca kávé, remekül egyensúlyozva a magas alkoholtartalmat.

name: Antimatter - Imperial Coffee Stout
text: For those of you who drink 8% coffee stouts for breakfast, we've developed Antimatter: a double ristretto among Starbucks lattes.This espresso-roast heavyweight rests on a foundation of coffee and chocolate malts blended with silky oats, brown sugar, and a delicate touch of lactose.We pile a trio of very special beans onto that base, all from Budapest's own Bagira Coffee. Two dark roasts are core to the Gravity blend: a milk chocolate, nougat-laden Brazilian, and an El Salvadorian bean full of tobacco and strawberry notes. The third is a very special guest, a medium-roast Yellow Catuai bean from Brazil, naturally-fermented for 120 hours for distinctive aromas of sweet coconut and sour cherry.

name: Roasters Paradise Pampojilá - Guatemala
text: collab with CASINO MOCCA

name: Asleep In The Deep
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT TEAM SERIES BENCEAntilles Rum Barrel Aged Imperial Milk Stout With Hazelnut, Cocoa And VanillaCELLAR MASTER NOTESSo the time has finally come when we release a beer that is even thicker than the last one we said was thicker than the previous, again. BUT this time it really is. Tons of lactose, chocolate and NUTs. ELAborating a beer is always full of fun with nuts because the selection is huge and (almost) every one of them is delicious. For the beer, we had a chance to take a chance on a new barrel type and Antilles rum turned out quite good. The results can be circumscribed as a hazelnut-chocolate spread rounded up with vanilla and aged in a rum barrel, for, you know... Reasons. And science.

name: Tiny Barrel Project Madame Kairi
text: Hot Sauce And Mezcal Barrel Aged Imperial StoutA TINY BARREL PROJECT that is unique in every respect, as it is the only one without a previous original release within the SPECIALS series. The launch was scheduled for the time of Tallinn Craft Beer Weekend 2025, after the first day, during the traditional MAD SCIENTIST TTO + MEET THE BREWER event at KOHT.We felt it was important to commemorate a very dear friend, supporter and our Estonian mother, thanks to whom KOHT has always been our home away from home... We always had tap takeovers together during every TCBW, she often came to Budapest to pick up goods in person with her truck, it was always a pleasure to meet her, we event talked about a collab beer last year and this year we fixed it already to do one of the upcoming TINY BARREL PROJECT releases together, as a collab with KOHT. Well, this collab has happened in a different way unfortunately... But it has happened.After TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD RUM and TINY BARREL PROJECT CANDY MAN SCOTCH and so, here is our 14th TINY BARREL PROJECT release in our new category between the Specials series and Barrel Project in 330ml cans

name: Black Horchata
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTA Blend Of Imperial Milk Stout And Imperial Porter Aged In Bourbon Barrel With Vanilla And CinnamonCELLAR MASTER NOTESThe king of crowdpleasers, dear Ladies and Gentlemen and other earthlings! Black Horchata launches a smooth attack against your taste buds with the power of vanilla and cinnamon, blackboned (sic!) by a stout full with lactose that has been aged for more than 1 year in a Kentucky bourbon barrel. The name comes from its undeniable similarity with the well-known Mexican soft drink but beyond this, we can't really recommend it for breakfast. You know. It's 11% ABV. Maybe for lunch.

name: Mental Trainer
text: Kentucky bourbon barrel aged milk imperial stout

name: Fear of the Dark I.
text: Heavy weight milk imperial stout aged in kentucky bourbon maple syrup oak barrel for a year

name: MMS³ - Madártejes Milk Stout
text: Még selymesebb, még krémesebb a kortyérzet mint az első két kiadásnál! A cél Szilárd anyukájának a Madárteje volt! A Milk Stoutban alapból van kakaó, vanília és laktóz ami megadja a desszertes alaphangot. Ehhez jött még hozzá további rengeteg laktóz és brutális mennyiségű vanília.

name: Fear of the Dark II.
text: Double barrel aged milk imperial stout, aged for months in JD Kentucky Bourbon barrel, and more than half year at kentucky bourbon maple syrup barrel.

name: Supermassive - Imperial Stout with Coconut, Cinnamon, and Pecans (2025)
text: Supermassive is the culmination of our high-ABV prototyping program, a project that has been in the works since 2023. Experience from prototypes like the Imperial Oatmeal Stout and the C/M/T have helped us to refine our maximum-gravity process, which now transitions into an ongoing high-ABV series with new releases arriving annually.Prepare yourself for an extreme brew that pushes the limits of our brewhouse, with a 14% ABV and the same rich, velvety foundation that defines Gravity’s Imperial range. Packed with roasted malts and silky oats, the Supermassive base showcases tons of chocolate, coffee, and dark caramel character. This huge base demands an extra long infusion on two different toasted oaks, specifically chosen to further deepen the rum and vanilla character.For this first edition of Supermassive, coconut sugar, coconut water, and toasted coconut flakes provide the backbone of the flavour: complex, fragrant, roasted coconut notes with a hint of salinity. Stacked onto that base are cinnamon buds which dominate the nose with a captivating aroma of soft, fruity winter spice, while toasted pecans finish the sip with a lingering nutty richness.

name: Prototype: Imperial Oatmeal Stout
text: Our newest Prototype is an Imperial Oatmeal Stout, and the start of something big here at Gravity!This dark, rich, and roasty brew is an all-new in-house imperial base inspired by San Diego’s legendary Modern Times, and their Devil’s Teeth series of more than 100 different imperial stouts. Think huge doses of malted oats, backed up by tones of chocolate, coffee, and complex caramel. A light touch of lactose balances the body, while organic coconut sugar helps the finish linger on the palate.This project will serve as the foundation for a new series of limited-release high-ABV beers, which we'll build on with new ingredients and infusion techniques to unleash bold new flavors and aromas.

name: Sweet Spot
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTA Blend Of Double Barrel (Bourbon & Sherry) Aged Imperial Stout And Tequila Barrel Aged MeadCELLAR MASTER NOTESIn the perpetual seek for an optimum point or combination of factors or qualitiesWe are about to release our first Barre Project stout-mead hybrid and we couldn't be more excited. To grab life by the throat we picked a medium-dry imperial stout that was aged for almost 2 years in 2 barrels (first Bourbon, then Oloroso sherry) and we mixed it with a sweet mead that sat in a tequila barrel for more than a year. The result is a brand new category, at least from our point of view, where chocolate, berries, and the spicy-sweet honey characters are the main pillars, but beyond that oakiness, vanilla and a whole bunch of other paper-thin notes collide, you know, just to make sure you can find your sweet spot!

name: Beeznuts
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTA Blend Of Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout And Also Bourbon Barrel-aged Mead With Hand Roasted Pistachios And WalnutCELLAR MASTER NOTESI Hustle EverydayAs a direct successor of Sweet Spot, this following release brings the sweet-honeylike-chocolaty notes of the 'Spot, but adds the bourbonish vanilla together with generously added and carefully roasted walnuts and pistachios. We don't need to sell the story of this mead-imperial stout crossover line, because it's not a story, it's the real deal and we hope you'll enjoy it as much as we do. "Money cannot buy happiness, it's true what they say, but a mad scientist still got bills to pay, so I hustle every day!"

name: Flódni
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECTJamaican And Cuban Rum Barrel Aged Imperial Pastry Stout With Plum, Apple, Walnut And Poppy SeedsCELLAR MASTER NOTESAs we roll further down the road to total madness we bumped into something, again, that is totally worth stopping by: Flódni, a Jewish pastry, one of the best cakes you could ever try. It's a heavily layered treat filled with apple, plum, poppyseed, walnut, citrus zests and cinnamon. We managed to translate this creation into a thick, fully packed, sweet dessert beer that was aged in Cuban and Jamaican rum barrels for more than a year to get extra spicy. It's a perfect union of (not so) contrary things!

name: Tiny Barrel Project Biscuit Behemoth
text: From 2018 COOKIE MONSTER chocolate chip imperial stout to 2023's first half's BISCUIT BEHEMOTH cookies & cream imperial stout ending up with 2023's second half's TINY BARREL PROJECT BISCUIT BEHEMOTH COGNAC barrel-aged chocolate cookies & vanilla cream imperial stout w/ Beer Brothers Budapest.Following TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD RUM and TINY BARREL PROJECT SPIRITLORD BOURBON, here is our third TINY BARREL PROJECT release in our new category between the Specials series and Barrel Project in 330ml cans.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2021 Imperial Pastry Stout Aged In Rhum Barrels
text: This Imperial Pastry Stout is aged in Rhum barrels, to give a nice layer for the additional spices we used during the brewing and aging process. The used adjuncts are coca nibs, ethipoean coffee, cinnamon and vanilla.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2025 / Peanut Butter Jelly Imperial Pastry Stout Aged In Pedro Ximénez Sherry Barrels
text: Gyerekkor legjobb szendvicse - csak felnőtteknek. Egy gazdag, testes imperial stout mogyoróvajjal, amit Pedro Ximénez sherry hordókban érleltünk. A végeredmény selymes, desszertszerű, tele pörkölt mogyorós, karamelles, mazsolás és lekváros jegyekkel, az érlelés pedig édeskés, boros-fügés mélységet ad.-The best childhood sandwich – for grown-ups. A rich, full-bodied imperial stout infused with peanut butter and aged in Pedro Ximénez sherry barrels. Silky and dessert-like, with roasted peanut, caramel, raisin and jam notes, rounded out by sweet, winey, fig-like barrel depth.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2025 / Imperial Pastry Stout Aged In Rum Barrels With Coconut & Chocolate
text: Folytatjuk az Imperial Pastry Stout sorozatunkat, most pedig egy különleges tétellel! Inspirációnk a közkedvelt kókuszkocka volt, és elkészült a sör verziója – tényleg olyan, mintha kókuszkockát kortyolnál. Rumoshordókban érleltük, kókuszpehellyel és kakaóbabbal, hogy minden korty a klasszikus rumos-kókuszos-csokis ízeket hozza el neked. Egészségedre! -We’re continuing our Imperial Pastry Stout series with a very special release. Inspired by the beloved coconut cube, we’ve created a beer that tastes just like it. Aged in rum barrels from Barbados, with coconut flakes and cocoa nibs, this stout captures the classic rum, coconut, and chocolate flavors in every sip. Cheers!

name: Candy Man Gold EDT
text: Imperial Stout With Almonds, Mahlep, Marshmallows And Tonka BeansOur infamous imperial stout, our bestseller special CANDY MAN is finally getting a can-only, limited, special edition!

name: Moment In Time 2025: Heaven Hill Bourbon /w Mexican Vanilla
Memphis Mafia 2024 Gold EDT

name: MMMMM
text: Maple Barrel Aged Coconut Scoop Stout.A Maple syrup barrel aged Imperial Stout infused with Thai coconut purée and vanilla ice cream.In a collaboration with MS Barrel Project.

name: Somlói Nodler
text: MAD SCIENTIST BARREL PROJECT collab with our friends at De Moersleutel (NL) 2nd barrel (you can find the 1st one as SOMLÓI GALUSKA)Hungarian dessert inspired Imperial Stout with Walnuts and Pecan Nuts aged in a Jamaican Rum BarrelCELLAR MASTER NOTESThis is a relaunch of the Somlói Galuska barrel project. Inspired by the hungarian dessert? Check. Jamaican rum barrel aged? Check. Creamy stout with notes of raisins and rum? Check. The only difference is what is more accented. Same content with a little bit different presentation.

name: Biscuit Behemoth
text: 2018's COOKIE MONSTER chocolate chip imperial stout is now 2023's BISCUIT BEHEMOTH cookies & cream imperial stout

name: Blurry Holiday
text: Our celebratory imperial pastry stout for every holiday occasion, you want to make blurry a bit. A bangin' thick 11% bursting with flavours of Ethiopean coffee, vanilla, cocoa beans, cinammon and almonds, this will sure to relax you and let you enjoy the holidays. Cheers! // Ünnepi stoutunk egy folyékony sütemény, ami kikapcsol és hagyja, hogy nyugodtan és lelazultan élvezd az ünnepeket. Etióp kávé, vanília, kakaóbab, fahéj és mandula sütibeillő összejátéka.

name: Stone Cold Riff

name: Corvus Corax
text: ENA massive, dense Imperial Stout made with our friends at Vogelsang. One of the densest in terms of taste and texture, it is especially for fans of full-bodied stouts and those who escape the trap of General Winter with a warming, stout beer.Candy sugar and maple syrup both leave their recognizable mark on our caramelly, brownie-like batch, which is complemented by the flavors of nuts and cookies and makes it totally pastry-like.DEEin massives, dichtes Imperial Stout, das wir mit unseren Freunden von Vogelsangos gebraut haben. Es ist eines der dichtesten in Bezug auf Geschmack und Textur und eignet sich besonders für Fans vollmundiger Stouts und für alle, die der Falle des General Winter mit einem wärmenden, kräftigen Bier entfliehen möchten.Sowohl Kandiszucker als auch Ahornsirup hinterlassen ihre unverwechselbare Note auf unserer Karamell-Brownie-Charge, die durch die Aromen von Nüssen und Keksen ergänzt wird und sie absolut gebäckartig macht.HUVogelsangos barátainkkal közösen készített masszív, sűrű Imperial Stout. Kortyérzetre, textúrára az eddigi egyik legsűrűbb darab, kifejezetten a testes stoutok rajongóinak és azoknak, akik Tél Tábornok csapdájából egy melengető, vaskos sörrel menekülnek.A kandiscukor és juharszirup mind rányomják felismerhető bélyegüket karamelles, brownies tételünkre, melyet a dió és a keksz ízei egészítenek ki és tesznek totálisan péksüteményszerűvé.

name: Christmas With Kids
text: IMPERIAL PASTRY STOUT WITH PEANUTS, COCOABEANS, TONKABEANS AND VANILLAMALÁTÁK:pale ale, oat flake, vienna, melanoidin,special w, crystal 400, biscuit, ruby,cara blond, chocolate, carafa special III,chocolate wheat maltKOMLÓK:styrian golding celeia

name: The Marshmallow Fellow
text: Amikor nem is számítasz rá... amikor békésen hallgatod a tűz ropogását... eljön érted a Marshmallow Fellow! A sűrű, ragacsos sötétségből veti rád magát, hogy elsőre kókuszos kekszre, másodikra már forrón olvadó pillecukorra emlékeztető ízkavalkádjával fektessen két vállra!When you least expect it... when there's only the peaceful crackling of the fire... the Marshmallow Fellow comes for you! He lurches at you from the deep, sticky darkness, to knock you out with a cacophony of flavours - coconut biscuit first, melted marshmallow second!

name: Luckies
text: Thick, oily bodied oatmeal stout with El Salvador Pacamara coffee beans from our friends at the Lucky Cap Roastery and some Madagascar vanilla beans. The name Luckies refers to the lucky experiment during the brewing process that resulted the extremely oily mouthfeel and the Lucky cap coffee.

name: Sir Banghard
text: Olivér, üzemvezetőnk mély, és zsigeri vágyat érzett arra, hogy az eredeti Banghard receptet durván megdolgozza. Mivel imádja a kókuszt, nem sajnálta belőle. Furfangos ember, és azt gondolta, legyen ez a sör sour, és az emberek örülni fognak. Reméljük mindenki örül!

name: Salted Caramel Chocolate Roller
text: Salted Caramel Pastry Stout

name: Night Shift Vintage 2024 - Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: Ezzel a tétellel visszatérünk a 2016-os gyökereinkhez, ami ismét Tennessee whiskey hordókban érlelődött. Fűszerek nélkül, csak a hordók, a maláta és a komló. 2 évig érlelve. Back to our 2016 roots, this 2024 batch is aged in Tennessee Whiskey barrels. No spices, just the barrels, malt, and hops. Aged for 2 years.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2023 - Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Tennessee Whiskey Barrels
text: A kezdetektől tudtuk, hogy ez a sör végig fog kísérni minket a Night Shift sztorin, és így is lett. Semmi cifrázás, csak az alapsör puszta ereje és a Tennessee Whiskey hordók utánozhatatlan ízjegyei kellettek ahhoz a csodához, amit ebbe a palackba zártunk. We knew it from the start that this beer would follow us through the Night Shift story. And we were right. Nothing special, only the base beer and the incredible taste from the barrels, that's all this extraordinary beer needed for the harmonious taste you're about to meet.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2020 Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Rum Barrels With Chocolate & Coconut
text: This beer is a 12% ABV Russian Imperial Stout, brewed with 12 types of malts, 6 hours of boil time, and 3 months of fermenting to prepare it for a long journey in freshly emptied Rum Barrels. These casks give this thick, dark, black beer rich notes of raisin and rum,which we spiced up with some extra cocoa beans from Ghana and some roasted coconut flakes. We strongly recommend it for every beer specialty lover.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2025 / Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Bourbon Maple Syrup Barrels With Chocolate & Coffee
text: Éjfekete, testes Russian Imperial Stout, amit frissen pörkölt Costa Rica-i és Etióp kávéval, valamint ghánai kakaóbabbal készítettünk. Ezután Bourbon és juharszirupos ex-Bourbon hordókban érleltük, hogy mély, édes-füstös, kávés-csokis komplexitást kapjon. Egy sör, ami egyszerre erős, kifinomult és elképesztően kényeztető.-Jet-black, full-bodied Russian Imperial Stout brewed with freshly roasted Costa Rican and Ethiopian coffee and Ghanaian cocoa. Aged in Bourbon and maple syrup ex-Bourbon barrels for deep, sweet-smoky chocolate and coffee complexity - bold, refined, and utterly indulgent.

name: Candy Man
text: Imperial Stout With Marshmallows And Tonka Beans The previous batches were between 11,5-12,0% 2025's new batch has the abv of 12,7%

name: Night Shift (Vintage 2019 Tennessee Whiskey Barrel Aged)
text: Our 2019 Vintage imperial stout,  aged in used Jack Daniels barrels for 6 months. Vanilla, toasted coconut, dark chocolate, coffe and a hint of smoke. Perfect for winter night shifts.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2024 - Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Pedro Ximénez Sherry & Rum Barrels W. Orange & Chocolate
text: Ezzel a tétellel egy klasszikusnak mondható, narancsos-csokis koncepciót szerettünk volna összehozni az alap Russian Imperial Stout édeskés, csokis ízjegyeivel. Az alapsör csak nekünk, teljesen frissen ürített Pedro Ximénez Sherry, illetve rumos hordókban pihent 6 hónapig, majd, amikor elnyerte tökéletes formáját, adtunk hozzá ghánai kakaóbabot és narancsot, hogy citrusos ízjegyeivel valóban visszaadja a trópusi hangulatot. A végeredmény egy hihetetlenül csokis, kellemesen citrusos, narancsos tétel lett, amelynek minden kortyában visszaköszön a megszokott édesség ízvilága. name: Event Horizon - Overproof Stout
text: This is Gravity turned up to 11.Our longest-running imperial, Event Horizon is an ultra-rich stout that takes its styling from high-proof Caribbean rums. Its deep molasses nose gives way to a chocolate & toffee body absolutely stacked with malt & grain complexity. Undertones of raisins and plums taper slowly into a finish of tart red fruit.

name: Night Shift (Vintage 2019 Caribbean Rum Barrel Aged)
text: Our 2019 Vintage imperial stout, aged in used Plantation rum barrels for 6 months. Vanilla, toasted coconut, dark chocolate, booze and warming spices. Perfect for winter night shifts.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2025 / Russian Imperial Stout Aged In Rhum And Vanilla Macadamia Rum Barrels
text: Klasszikus Russian Imperial Stout, kétféle hordóban újragondolva: az egyik rész frissen ürített Rhum hordóban, a másik Rumos hordóban érlelődött, melyekben korábban makadámdió és vanília pihent. A végeredmény egy selymes, mély, diós-vaníliás karakterű sör, finom rumos édességgel és krémes lecsengéssel.-A reimagined Russian Imperial Stout aged in both fresh Rhum barrels and Rum barrels previously holding macadamia nuts and vanilla. The result is silky and rich, with nutty-vanilla layers, subtle rum sweetness, and a smooth, creamy finish.

name: Night Shift (Vintage 2018 Tennessee Whiskey Barrel Aged)
text: Limited version of our 2018 Vintage imperial stout. Aged in used Jack Daniels barrels for 5 months. Vanilla, toasted coconut, dark chocolate, coffe and a hint of smoke. Perfect for winter night shifts.

name: Boris the Blade (2018)
text: Traditional Russian Imperial Stout made with 7 different malts, it has rich taste and rich smell. The full-bodied, dark and thick drink is aged for a year for the perfect ratio of the hop and the malt. High alcohol percentage, berries and dried fruits with a light caramel-truffle finish. It is a beer to remember.

name: Boris (2019)
text: A Boris 2019-es változata. Sűrű és robosztus Russian Imperial Stout, amelyet szintén egy évig érleltünk mielőtt a piacra került.  Étcsokoládés, karamelles és kávés jegyek dominálnak illatban és ízben egyaránt. Nagy test, hosszú lecsengés és enyhe keserűség a korty végén. Sorszámozott és évjáratos palackok, exkluzív pezsgős palack, parafadugós zárás.---Boris vintage 2019! Creamy and robust RIS aged in bottle for a year before release. Dark chocolate, caramel and coffee aromas in the nose and in the taste. Full body, long aftertaste, light bitterness in the end. Enumerated, exclusive vintage champagne bottle closed with cork.

name: Dagon
text: 2020. decemberéig 4 hónapot tartályban, 11-et rumos fahordóban érleltük ezt a sűrű, tartalmas Russian Imperial Stoutot.Lekerekedett alkohol, összesimult ízjegyek jellemzik, harsányan rumos és hordós jegyekkel. A palackokat egyesével, a legnagyobb gondossággal töltöttük.

name: Gemenc Illusion
text: Gemenci whiskys hordóban érlelt Russian Imperial Stout

name: Eclipse - Imperial Smoked Stout
text: Eclipse is an imperial that focuses on a lighter element: smoke.Cherry- and oak-smoked grains form a delicate balance between bright red fruit and dry tannin, while Lapsang Souchong from the mountain tea plantations of Fujian lends soft pine forest aromas to the nose.These delicate wisps settle onto a stout base that exercises restraint above all: a refined balance of black malt, toasted grains, and dark caramel, smoothed out by silky oats and a touch of lactose. The finish offers a subtle linger of cocoa powder, and warms the throat to embrace the next sip.

name: Night Shift Vintage 2020 Wheat Wine Aged in Rum Barrels
text: It's a 13% ABV Wheat Wine, that was brewed with 4 types of malts, 8 hours of boil time, and 3 months of fermenting to prepare it for a long journey in freshly emptied Barbados Rum Barrels. This wheat malt based, high alcohol beer contains copious amounts of noble German hops, and was aged for 12 months in oak barrels. The result is a silky, creamy wheat wine, with incredible complexity.

name: Generations 2017-20 Blend
text: Ezt a söritalt 2017 decembere óta érleltük 225 literes Bock (Villány) és 500 literes Takler (Szekszárd) hordóban a korábban már jól bevált élesztő kultúránkkal. 2020 júliusától a belőlük készült blend-et palackokba töltve érleltük tovább.  A hosszú érlelési idő alatt lejátszódó folyamatokat befolyásoló tényezők egyedisége (hőingadozás, hordó adottságai stb.) miatt a végeredmény egyszeri és megismételhetetlen.Ez a sör egy rusztikus (lambic-ra emlékeztető) kellemesen savanyú, komplex, de mégsem nehéz ital.Összesen 400 palack készült.

name: Botanical Roots
text: Wild Ale Blend with Medlars

name: GENERATIONS RELOAD SCHIEBER 2024
text: Generations sorozatunk tagjai vörösboros hordóban érlelt wild ale típusú (savanyú) sörök. Ez a világos sörital 2020 decembere óta "pihent" 225 literes vörösboros hordóban, melyet a szekszárdi Schieber Borászattól vásároltunk. 2023 júniusa óta palackban érleljük.A hosszú érlelési idő alatt lejátszódó folyamatokat befolyásoló tényezők egyedisége (hőingadozás, hordó adottságai stb.) miatt a végeredmény egyszeri és megismételhetetlen.Összesen 264 palack készült.
